name: Taliesin inline
comment: Inline Taliesin deltas that must fire MID-PARAGRAPH (where markdown's inline context owns tokens): $-math, {{< shortcodes >}}, @xref, [@cite]. Injected into text.tmd.markdown ONLY (via package.json injectTo) so it never leaks into plain .md files. The injectionSelector keeps these out of code cells / fenced code / comments (so an `@` in python or a `$` in a shell block is not tokenized). Grounded: math mod.rs:28,1662; shortcodes extension/mod.rs:364; xref cite/render.rs:11,285; cite render.rs:312.

math_inline.comment: $ … $ inline. Guarded so `$5` currency / a `$` adjacent to a word is not opened. The body is scoped meta.embedded.math.tmd → mapped to latex by embeddedLanguages (VS Code embeds a LaTeX grammar IF one is installed; NO hard `include: text.tex`, which VS Code does not bundle and which silently disables the rule when unresolved).
math_inline.name: markup.math.inline.tmd

xref.comment: Bare @fig-/@sec-/@tbl-/@eq-/@lst-/@thm-/@lem-/@cor-/@prp-/@def-/@exm-/@rem- reference (cite/render.rs:11,285). The lookbehind reproduces the parser's word-boundary guard so bob@rem-server.com is NOT a reference.
xref.name: markup.other.reference.tmd support.variable.reference.tmd

cite.comment: [@key] citation group, incl. [@a; @b, p. 5] and [-@key] (render.rs:312). A cross-ref key in brackets ([@fig-x]) is rendered as an xref by the engine but is fine cite-styled here.
cite.name: markup.other.citation.tmd
